record.title: Notice on matters concerning the orderly promotion of green-power direct connection
record.issuer: National Development and Reform Commission (NDRC); National Energy Administration (NEA)
record.relation_note: Single-user green-power direct-connection framework (a dedicated line supplying green power to a single electricity user); extended to multi-user cases in 2026 by Fagai Nengyuan [2026] No. 688 (WA-DOC-2026-0102); this announcement has not been superseded
record.note: NDRC original text (signed 21 May 2025, published on the website 30 May 2025); key ratios cross-checked against the 2026 multi-user document and the NEA press Q&A.
